overview: 本单元依据 FRM-like/1 的下列精确运算： `init: cclassic = c; z = pixel; cclassic = z. loop: z = z * z + cclassic; cclassic = (1 + imag(cclassic)) * real(cclassic) / 2 + z. bailout: |z| <= 4.`

sourceWalkthrough.58edc237-4978-5aed-8229-028b1d9cbbb9:e59: 此标注执行 `z = z * z + cclassic`.
此标注执行 `cclassic = (1 + imag(cclassic)) * real(cclassic) / 2 + z`.
此标注执行 `|z| <= 4`. 它终结本公式上方所述的迭代序列。
